summary: Iteration 2 full-stack test for DORIN TRAVEL (Google OAuth + Blog CRUD + Email automation + Rebrand). All 23 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend verified: rebrand complete (no VOYARA anywhere), Google-only login/signup pages, admin seeded cookie opens /admin, Blog editor create/delete via UI works end-to-end and new article appears on public /blog, customer dashboard renders all 5 tabs, /login redirects authenticated admin to /admin.

minor.issue: Emergent email proxy returns 422 for arbitrary throwaway recipient emails (e.g. qa.customer.<ts>@example.com) during customer-trips test. Enquiry still succeeds (lead saved); only email send is rejected. Using delivered@resend.dev returns 202 as expected. Not a product bug — expected provider sandbox behavior, but worth noting in docs.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (ContactPage.js line 60). Non-blocking console warning only.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning on ContactPage: remove the wrapping <span> inside each <option> (likely from a dynamic expression wrapper in the <option>'s text).
(Optional) Document that email proxy only accepts whitelisted / delivered@resend.dev addresses for automated QA.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 719 lines — consider splitting routers (auth, blog, leads, analytics, me) into submodules for maintainability.
update_article uses ObjectId(article_id) without a try/except — malformed ids will 500 instead of 400/404. Minor.
/api/analytics/track is unauthenticated and unrate-limited — could be abused to spam the events collection.
get_current_user falls back to Bearer which is a plain session token (not JWT). Acceptable per playbook, but if ever exposed in a header, treat as sensitive.
No index on blog_articles.date / leads.user_id — fine at current scale.
test_credentials: Admin pre-seeded: session_token=test_admin_session_token_123 (spinudorin10@gmail.com). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is STALE (still references removed JWT register/login/password flow) — recommend main agent update it to reflect the Google-OAuth playbook from /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Created transient customer users+sessions in Mongo (test_database.users / user_sessions) for dashboard+preferences+saved+trips tests. Created one TEST_ blog article via UI and deleted it in the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover: auth (no cookie 401, missing session-id 400, removed register/login endpoints, admin cookie + Bearer), blog public, blog admin CRUD w/ 401+403 negative paths, leads newsletter/enquiry/contact (triggers Resend 202), admin-only /api/leads, dashboard (preferences PUT, saved toggle, trips, logout), analytics track + admin summary. Pre-seeded admin session_token=test_admin_session_token_123. Email proxy accepts delivered@resend.dev; other test addresses return 422 (logged by server, not fatal).
